title: An independent verifier used gold-label length as a prediction feature and obtained a spurious perfect score

source.evidence_note: Observed local historical transcript; see evidence/incident.md. Source aliases map privately; Submission of these prepared files was authorized on 2026-10-11.

horizon.intervening_work: Independent dataset/conformance checks and structural feature construction. Ground truth and metadata coexisted in the same row, creating the opportunity to confuse field location with permissible feature provenance.
horizon.mechanism: Observed label leakage in a verifier. This short recovered analysis bug is useful evidence, but is not an example of a false final completion or demonstrated long-horizon collapse.

failure.expected_behavior: Independently verify that prediction from structural metadata remains below a specified ceiling; labels may score predictions but must not be predictive inputs.
failure.observed_behavior: The verifier included the length of the gold-label string among features. Because the two label strings have different lengths, the implementation directly encoded the answer and produced cross-validation accuracy 1.0.
failure.target_predicate: See checks/README.md; task completion and target error are assessed separately.

comparison_note: No model attempt or causal control has run. A scripted faulty fixture and correct reference, where recorded, validate the checker only.
